اعتزما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمَا (iʕtazamā) /iʕ.ta.za.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمَا (uʕtuzimā) /uʕ.tu.zi.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اِعْتَزِمَا (iʕtazimā) /iʕ.ta.zi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
